candidates.defline: The Twin lives inside your Year Gate: the root of your early world was learning to hold your own.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Growth. Somewhere in the first chapters, you became your own backup: a childhood that asked you to be sturdy early, among siblings, cousins, or a house that treated small people as capable ones. The root took. Self-reliance, for you, is a place you come from rather than a skill you learned. Watch one thing: roots this firm can quietly refuse replanting. Some help is worth accepting just to remember how.
